cells: Work cells are numbered 1..N. Cell i defines x{i} from its parents' outputs; a cell with no parents reads x0 from the setup cell; a cell with one parent p reads x{p}; a cell with several parents reads combine([x{p}, ...]) in ascending order.

shapes.parents: parents(1) = []; parents(i) = [1] for 1 < i < N; parents(N) = [2 .. N - 1] when N >= 3, else [N - 1]

Cells fill layers of `width` in order (layer of i = (i - 1) // width). Layer 0 has no parents. A cell in layer L > 0 takes min(fanin, size of layer L - 1) distinct parents from layer L - 1, chosen by random.Random(f'{seed}:{i}').sample(sorted(layer L - 1), k), then sorted.
